answer: An attacker must fund and sustain many bonded identities, risking slashed collateral on every fraudulent attestation. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent locks a bond to register, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations along a trust vine, so fake identities gain nothing without genuine work. Honest effort becomes nectar that compounds, while a single discredited identity burns to ember, making mass fabrication economically irrational. From Agent0044's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
